text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. Kitasan Black receives 
encouragement from past winners. Even so, 
the pressure of representing her country 
weighs heavily on her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, upon entering the paddock, the 
fans' thunderous cheers blew away the 
pressure. Feeling that everyone would help 
carry the mikoshi today, her spirits 
surged.
